profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: A motivated self-starter with a penchant for the startup life designing and writing efficient, secure, DRY code and REST-ful interfaces. Over 5 years of direct experience architecting and executing commercial web services, including smartphone and 3rd party provider interfaces, and a system to securely handle sensitive health information. 4 years of experience performing computer/network vulnerability analysis and exploit and defense development.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Improving datacenter cooling efficiency using machine learning.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: A continuation and extension of tasks at Catalog Spree, following an acquisition. Developed a new backend processing system for a re-purpose of an existing product. Furthermore, was responsible for integration with Quotient systems, particularly involving data exchange. Python, Django, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Celery, Solr, Akamai, Ansible, Apache, nginx, Linux

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Served as lead backend engineer. Key responsibilities included design and implementation of client interfaces, development and maintenance of back-end publishing processes including content distribution via Akamai, improvement and maintenance of feed processing, product search, database schema design, design and implementation of a data analytics system with our data scientist, and administration of all servers. Python, Django, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Celery, Solr, Akamai, Apache, nginx+varnish, Linux, cacti, openvpn

positions.title: CTO / Cofounder
positions.description: Planned, architected, and largely implemented a SaaS unified communication platform and automated answering service for doctors. Major components include a secure messaging and file sharing system (with requisite key management system), telephony services including an IVR and SMS messaging, various JavaScript browser-side applications including an on-call scheduler, and a smartphone application interface. Further duties included management of engineering resources, QA, server administration (LAMP), and web/graphic design and implementation.
